verdict.rationale: Make documents a Custom Apps developer platform with defined app components (Base, Connections, Webhooks, Modules, Remote Procedure Calls) and an editor choice, which is the product's own way to build custom connectors. It also offers an official TypeScript SDK for the Make API. However, the evidence for the custom-app platform is only a table of contents, so the depth of the connector-building workflow is unproven. missing for 10: substantive docs on building, testing and deploying a custom app, explicit evidence of private (unpublished) integration sharing, a CLI or connector-specific SDK, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build a custom connector or private integration with a documented developer platform, SDK, or CLI

citations.quote: The Make Typescript SDK provides full support for type definitions and a majority of Make API endpoints, built-in error handling, and response typing.
